data.long_meaning: A name of Arabic origin meaning contentment, satisfaction, and joy. Derived from the word 'Rahana' in Arabic, which means 'to be content' or 'to be satisfied'. The name Rehena carries the meaning “Contentment, Satisfaction” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rehena usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, satisfaction and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rehena total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
